title: Polynomial query-budget bound
statement: Let $n,C,Q$ be natural numbers, let $t>0$ be rational, and let $0<\varepsilon\le1/2$ be rational. Assume $1\le n$, $1/(Q+1)\le\varepsilon$, and $t\le(C+1)(\sqrt{\lceil\log_2(n+1)\rceil}+1)$. Define $d=\lceil8t/\varepsilon\rceil$, $\theta=(\varepsilon/8)^2t^{-2}(1/9)^d$, $c=\lceil2t/\theta\rceil$, $B=(d+1)(c+1)^d$, $a=8(C+1)(Q+1)+1$, $b=128(Q+1)^2(C+1)^3+4a+5$, and $e=2a(b+1)$. Then $2^{40}(n+1)^2(B+1)^8/\varepsilon^{10}\le 2^{40}(2^{2e}+1)^8(Q+1)^{10}(n+1)^{8e+2}$.
